description:
RC Sofia International wrote to her Club about the Flag exchange:

' A meeting that inspires :

What an honour and wonderful opportunity it was to meet Rtn Dinesh Sharma, someone whose interests and commitments reflect so beautifully the richness of life and the spirit of service!

Meeting someone who combines sport, creativity, international curiosity, and a commitment to giving back is truly inspiring.

This is the beauty of Rotary fellowship.

Dinesh’s visit to Sofia is a lovely reminder that Rotary brings together people from different countries and backgrounds, united by friendship, shared values, and the desire to make the world a better place."

Thank you Dinesh Sharma. ..you were truly an ambassador of RCBB, thanks for leaving such a lasting impression.
